title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE BUILDS
why: The card was stamped v19.91 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the body builds (v20.01 to v20.06: Lean, Broad and Curved, the jiggle, the teammate seeing it, the FASHION tiles and outfits fitting); the stash at 6 across (v19.98) and the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the body builds.
